strategies.statement: Operate as a customer-centric organisation, organised around end-to-end customer outcomes rather than internal functions
strategies.driver: Customers compare every interaction against best-in-class digital experiences regardless of industry
strategies.target-outcome: Net Promoter Score top-quartile in sector; 90% of frontline staff working in cross-functional customer-facing teams by end of 2027

strategies.statement: Run on outcome-based, cross-functional product teams with full ownership of their value stream
strategies.driver: Functional silos create handoff friction and dilute accountability for end-to-end performance
strategies.target-outcome: All value-creating work delivered by persistent product teams by 2026; no project-based funding for in-life products

strategies.statement: Decide with data — every material business decision must cite the evidence that supports it
strategies.driver: Decisions made on intuition are slow to challenge and slow to correct
strategies.target-outcome: Self-serve analytics available to every team; decision logs in place for executive-grade decisions

strategies.statement: Embed continuous discovery so investment follows learning, not the plan
strategies.driver: Annual planning cycles lock investment ahead of evidence and create sunk-cost momentum
strategies.target-outcome: Quarterly rebalancing of investment based on outcome evidence; no business case lifecycle exceeds the time to first learning

strategies.statement: Build digital-by-default operations — paper, manual handovers, and bespoke spreadsheets are exceptions, not the norm
strategies.driver: Manual operations cap throughput, hide quality issues, and erode margin
strategies.target-outcome: Top 20 business processes fully digital end-to-end by 2026

strategies.statement: Position sustainability as a primary capability of the business, not a reporting overlay
strategies.driver: Regulator, investor, and customer expectations on ESG are converging on operational standards, not disclosure
strategies.target-outcome: Carbon and ESG metrics owned by line management with operational KPIs; reporting is a by-product, not the goal
